subject: Connect flow
title: *One tap* to connect, whatever the wallet.
standfirst: Defines the wallet connection flow of the Parallel app for every supported wallet, mobile and desktop, for build starting 21 September 2026.

blocks.heading: One tap to connect, *whatever the wallet*
blocks.body: The connect button opens one sheet: the wallets found on the device first, then the rest. A returning user is reconnected silently. Every error names the wallet and the next action. The sheet is one component, used on every screen that needs a wallet; no screen may build its own.

blocks.source: Priorities agreed at the design review of 11 Sep 2026.

rows: Installed and injected wallets are listed first, detected at open
A returning user is reconnected without a sheet
Every error names the wallet and offers one next action
Wrong chain is handled inside the sheet, with a switch button
The sheet remembers the last wallet used, per device

bullets: Label "Connect"; once connected, the address shortened to six and four characters, the chain as a dot.
Wallet name and icon on one row each, 56 high; a section label above the second group; no search.
Two lines under the row: what happened, then one action. Never a modal, never red on its own.

blocks.source: Decide before build starts on 21 Sep.

rows: Do we list wallets we cannot detect, or hide them behind "Other"?
Silent reconnect after how many days?
